brief:
Palestinian women are filling support gaps across the West Bank through volunteer work, according to Palestine News Network, as civil society organizations assist children in returning to learning. The initiative addresses challenges ranging from economic hardship among women entrepreneurs to educational disruption affecting young people in the region.

The reporting examines how local organizations and volunteer efforts are mobilizing to bridge gaps left by broader systemic challenges. PNN's Accountability program documented the work of women managing small businesses alongside their volunteer commitments to support children's educational recovery.

title: Palestinian women volunteers help children resume education
